newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up, but off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up, but off early highs.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates ended up on Thursday, but were off early highs on surplus funds and could fall further on Friday, dealers said.
"Today was the settlement of 25.3 billion rupees of (six-month maturity) short-term federal bonds auction against an inflow of 16 billion rupees," one dealer said.

"In anticipation of shortage funds in the system, the overnight market traded at 18.95 percent in the morning," he said. "But the rates dropped to 14 percent owing to lack of borrowing interest towards the close."
